preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or authorized address
Contract must have trading enabled (tradingOpen = true)
Victim user must hold some tokens to be affected by fee increase

exploit_hint: As owner/authorized, call setFees() with extremely high fee values (e.g., 9900 for each fee component and feeDenominator 10000) to set total fee to 99%. Then perform token transfers with victim users to extract excessive fees. The fees accumulate in the contract and can be withdrawn via manualSend() to marketingFeeReceiver (which owner controls).
